[[File:Phil Aasen 2026 US Nationals.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Phil Aasen at the [[2026 U.S. National Championship]].]]
'''Phil Aasen''' (also listed as '''Phillip Aasen'''; GEMP handle '''karrdeshark''')<ref name="cc1" /> is a member of [[Team 5]]<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref> and the 2017 World Champion. He played the [[2026 San Diego Super Open]].<ref name="pc-sdso">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-04-san-diego-super-open-san-diego-california-apr-11-to-12-2026/ 2026-04 San Diego Super Open], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021000913/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-04-san-diego-super-open-san-diego-california-apr-11-to-12-2026.html Internet Archive]</ref>
